bias_targets.methodology: Thematic content analysis and critical scoping review of AI substitution proposals, conceptually evaluating the validity of claims that LLMs can act as human surrogates to accurately simulate diverse demographic groups (e.g., varying by gender, race, age, and socioeconomic status).

Critical evaluation based on literature review examining how relying on LLMs as human substitutes perpetuates cultural biases, conceptually analyzing how current models predominantly reflect Western, educated, industrialized, rich, and democratic (WEIRD) perspectives rather than true global diversity.
